label: L=3 sequences, copy phase (steps 4-5)
explanation: Length-3 detector during copy: fires almost only in sequences of length 3, on the two copy-phase steps after the delimiter (t=4, 5; recall_idx 1 and 2). 98% of activation mass is in L=3 copy steps. t=4 (input = first copied token, right after <DEL>) holds about 70% of the mass, t=5 about 28%, and the top activations are at t=4. It does not fire at t=0, at the delimiter, or anywhere after t=5. Longer sequences (L>=4) give only rare weak activations at original steps 1-2 (often on q). Precision is about 0.57: roughly 40% of L=3 copy steps stay below threshold, and that depends on token content in a way no simple variable captured (restricting by digits or repeats did not help).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: q, p, 1, s, 0, i; least: 3, v, e, j) and the previous input (most: c, q, e, u, v, w; least: k, n, r, x); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=4, L=3 & t=5, L=3.
